subject: AGENTS.md §6 (t60's landed sentence) overstates the path-comment count 2×: 26/24 are DIFF-OUTPUT lines, the true differing path comments are 13/12
where: AGENTS.md lines 350-354 (the §6 Build bullet), landed by t60
method: two builds per package into TEMP outfiles — repo-root path-qualified form vs package-directory form — then a full line-by-line comparison; no packages/** write
finding: The landed sentence says the artifact's path comments are '26 of them … 24 remain after dropping the first'. 26/24 is the diff-output convention (one `<` line plus one `>` line per differing source line); the artifact contains 13 `// ` comment lines, 12 of them after the entry line. A reader counting comments gets 13 — the number as written is not the thing it names.
not_affected: the rest of the sentence — 'not one banner line', the foreclosure of banner normalization, the canonical repo-root command, the three-package residual, the §4 pointer — is correct; the round-trip pair it rests on was re-reproduced byte-exactly in this measurement
addendum_correction: platform-engineer's line-diff-addendum.json uses the same convention for mpd-tools ('6 / 4'); the true positions are 3 / 2. Its structural classification (entry banner + one comment per inlined module, no code line differing) is CONFIRMED.
proposed_fix: in §6 replace the count clause with: 'the entry banner plus one comment per inlined module (13 such comment lines in the `mpd-ext-plugin` build, 12 of them after the entry line; measured)' — structural, portable to other packages, and it forecloses the normalization remedy without quoting any diff convention
re_measurement_needed_on_fix: reverse-substitution identity check against the pre-edit sha (single hunk, words only)
process_note: t60 is terminal; this is a NEW finding and needs its own repair contract before the wave commit. Not edited by me: the fix needs scope ownership (AGENTS.md) and a re-measurement, and the wave's requirement/task/review separation is what prevented a drive-by edit.
